name: Wormhole n150 tt-metal: Whisper distil-large-v3 batch-1 tok/s per user
unit: tok/s per user at batch 1 (equals aggregate at batch 1)
methodology: VENDOR demo in tenstorrent/tt-metal models/README.md speech-to-text table (matrix last updated 2025-12-08). Whisper distil-large-v3, single n150 (Wormhole), batch 1, TT-Metalium v0.65.0-dev20251208. t/s/u 105.0 = 1/inter-token-latency, and at batch 1 the aggregate t/s is also 105.0. Per-request, not a concurrent aggregate.
notes: Vendor demo numbers, not a vLLM serving trace. The README states t/s = t/s/u * batch and that vLLM-server performance may differ. LLM rows use input sequence length 128 except Mamba, which accepts any length. Starred Blackhole figures carry the vendor's own caveat that the software is still under active optimization.
